goals: Grow revenue and open more outlets
Spend less time on operations, more on the business
Build a loyal customer base that keeps coming back
Compete with bigger chains on customer experience

universal_insights.core_pain: Running an F&B or retail business in Southeast Asia is relentlessly hard — orders, staff, payments, commissions, and customer retention all pull in different directions. Business owners want tools that just work, in their language, without requiring an IT team.
universal_insights.core_desire: Spend less time firefighting operations and more time growing the business or being present with family.
universal_insights.key_emotional_hook: These merchants are hardworking, resilient entrepreneurs who deserve better tools. Celebrate their grit — position StoreHub as the partner that makes their business life easier.
ad_content_that_works: Real merchant faces and real shops (not stock imagery)
Before/after: 'I used to spend 3 hours on reconciliation, now it takes 5 minutes'
Social proof from merchants in same country/industry
Feature demos that show simplicity — 'even my staff can use it on day one'
